|text=This template uses the [[OpenStreetMap]] tag:
*'''''[https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:wikidata wikidata]''''' (see [https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Talk:Key:wikidata talk]; [https://taginfo.openstreetmap.org/keys/wikidata taginfo])
}}
{{Lua sidebar}}

This template generates a mapframe map, suitable for infoboxes, with minimal user input. This template only works with single features (points, lines, or shapes); use {{tlx|maplink}} if more advanced options, such as displaying multiple features, are required.

*A point marker will be displayed if local coordinates are supplied or if the page's Wikidata item does have an {{Q|P402}} or a {{Q|P3896}}.
*Shapes/lines will be displayed if local coordinates are not supplied or if the Wikidata item has either an {{Q|P402}} or a {{Q|P3896}}.
*No map will be shown if local coordinates are not supplied and if the Wikidata item does not have a {{Q|P625}}.

*See [[:Category:Infobox mapframe without OSM relation ID on Wikidata]] for pages which have items without an OSM Relation or a Geoshape.
*Troubleshooting shapes guidance is found at [[Module talk:mapframe/FAQ]]

== Usage ==
'''Note:''' When in mainspace, parameter {{para|id}} is not required (except to use a different page's data)

===Basic===
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe}}</syntaxhighlight>
When used without parameters, or with only {{para|id}}, the map will display shape/line features, if they are available at OpenStreet Map.
*If the Wikidata item does not specify an {{Q|P402}}, a point marker will be additionally shown.
{{cot|Basic usage examples}}
Point feature (Wikidata coordinates):
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe |id=Q7270550}}</syntaxhighlight>
{{Infobox mapframe |id=Q7270550}}
Line feature:
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe |id=Q1318331}}</syntaxhighlight>
{{Infobox mapframe |id=Q1318331}}
Shape feature:
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe |id=Q61}}</syntaxhighlight>
{{Infobox mapframe |id=Q61}}
{{cob}}

===Using specified coordinates instead of Wikidata===
Point feature only, no shapes or lines:
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe |coord=}}</syntaxhighlight>
Point feature and shape/line feature if available:
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe |wikidata=yes |coord=}}</syntaxhighlight>

Specify coordinates using the {{tlx|Coord}} templates, e.g. {{para|coord|2={{tlx|Coord|32.1|S|116.2|E}}}}
*If {{para|coord}} is specified, then a point marker will always been shown and shape/line features will be shown only if the Wikidata item has an {{Q|P402}} or a {{Q|P3896}}.
*If {{para|coord}} is specified and {{para|wikidata|yes}} is used, then the point marker and any shape/line features will always be shown (if available on OpenStreetMap).
{{cot|Specified coordinates examples}}
Point feature (with coordinates specified, no shape/line feature from Wikidata item):
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{infobox mapframe |coord={{coord|31|56|S|115|58|E}} }}</syntaxhighlight>
{{infobox mapframe |id=Q45935 |coord={{coord|31|56|S|115|58|E}} }}
Point feature (with coordinates specified, along with shape/line feature from Wikidata item):
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{infobox mapframe |wikidata=yes |coord={{coord|31|56|S|115|58|E}} }}</syntaxhighlight>
{{infobox mapframe |id=Q45935 |wikidata=yes |coord={{coord|31|56|S|115|58|E}} }}
{{cob}}

===Customizing which features are displayed===
====Inverse shape====
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe |shape=inverse}}</syntaxhighlight>
Replace the shape with an inverse-shape (geomask) by setting {{para|shape|inverse}}
{{cot|Inverse shape example}}
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe |id=Q61 |shape=inverse}}</syntaxhighlight>
{{Infobox mapframe |id=Q61}}
{{cob}}
{{Infobox mapframe |id=Q61}}

====Turn point marker on or off====
Force point marker to be displayed:
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe |point=on}}</syntaxhighlight>
Prevent point marker from being displayed:
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe |point=none}}</syntaxhighlight>

====Turn shape feature off====
Prevent shape feature from being displayed:
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe |shape=none}}</syntaxhighlight>

====Turn line feature off====
Prevent line feature from being displayed:
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe |line=none}}</syntaxhighlight>

===Show a geomask from a related Wikidata item===
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe |geomask=}}</syntaxhighlight>
Set {{para|geomask}} to a Wikidata item id (Q-number), or property id (P-number) such as {{Q|P17}}
{{cot|Geomask examples}}
Use the item linked from the {{q|P17}} statement as a geomask:
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe |id=Q3239281 |geomask=P17}}</syntaxhighlight>
{{Infobox mapframe |id=Q3239281 |geomask=P17}}
Use the item {{q|Q1199}} as a geomask:
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe |id=Q3239281 |geomask=Q1199}}</syntaxhighlight>
{{Infobox mapframe |id=Q3239281 |geomask=Q1199}}
{{cob}}

===Setting the zoom level===
The zoom level of the map can always be set by an editor via {{para|zoom}}. If not explicitly set, the zoom is determined automatically:
* If the Wikidata item has an {{Q|P402}} or {{Q|P3896}}, then the center and zoom of the image is set to nicely frame the shape/line.
* If the Wikidata item has an {{Q|P6592}}, it will be used as the zoom level
* Any of the following parameters will specify a zoom level:
**{{para|length_km}}
**{{para|length_mi}}
**{{para|width_km}}
**{{para|width_mi}}
**{{para|area_km2}}
**{{para|area_mi2}}
**{{para|area_ha}}
**{{para|area_acre}}
*The zoom will be set by specifying the {{para|type}} of the object, with the same usage as {{tl|coord}}. For example, {{para|type|city}}. In the case of a city, the population can determine the zoom by specifying {{para|population}}.

{{cot|Zoom examples}}
Set zoom manually
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe|coord={{coord|37|45|N|119|32|W}}|zoom=8}}</syntaxhighlight>
{{Infobox mapframe|coord={{coord|37|45|N|119|32|W}}|zoom=8}}

Determine zoom from object length in kilometres or miles
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe |id=Q1318331 |length_km=5.6}}</syntaxhighlight>
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe |id=Q1318331 |length_mi=3.5}}</syntaxhighlight>
{{Infobox mapframe |id=Q1318331 |length_km=5.6}}

Determine zoom from object area in square kilometres or square miles
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe |id=Q100 |area_km2=232.14}}</syntaxhighlight>
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox mapframe |id=Q100 |area_mi2=89.63}}</syntaxhighlight>
{{Infobox mapframe |id=Q100 |area_km2=232.14}}
{{cob}}

==Parameters==
All parameters are optional.

{{Infobox mapframe/doc/parameters|noprefix=yes|deprecated=yes}}
